messages:
maria_csm: Quick sync  Moss tenant goes live tomorrow 09:30 PT. I made a tiny prefill/warmup + handover checklist focused on cache keys, batching toggles, and a short renewal-watch rule. Pls ack and add any missing ops/TE bits.

dylan_sre: Ack. Ops notes: prefill top-15 prompts into KV, warm TTL=35s. Ramp plan: 0% -> 30% (10m) -> 70% (25m) -> 100% (1h). Start with batching disabled for first 5m, then batch_size=3, batch_window_ms=220. If p50 > 320ms after a step, roll back and set batch_size=1 + disable streaming.

akiko_te: Runtime toggles to expose to CSMs:
```yaml
tenant_toggle:
  enable_streaming: true
  initial_batch_size: 0
  batch_window_ms: 220
  cache_ttl_seconds: 35
  kv_prefix: moss/$TENANT
```
Note: initial_batch_size=0 forces streaming-only warmup; flip to >0 to test batching path. For embedding-heavy tenants bump cache_ttl_seconds to 75.

priya_pm: Renewal-watch rule (proposal): if day-3 DAU < 10% forecast AND avg_error_rate > 2% over 3h -> create renewal_watch and CSM outreach within 6h. CSM pre-call checklist: confirm API keys, run streaming handshake, verify KV prefill success, note whether fallback model used.

dylan_sre: On-call quick actions on backpressure: 1) set tenant_toggle.enable_streaming=false 2) set batch_size=1 3) toggle fallback_model=moss-light 4) if p95 > 1.1s for >12m, escalate to SRE. I'll add to eng-oncall.

akiko_te: Tiny curl smoke for streaming + KV check to add to onboarding script:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\
  -d '{"model":"moss-v1","stream":true,"input":"ping"}' | jq .stream_open
# then verify KV keys exist: curl -sS https://kv.redwood.example/kv/moss/$TENANT/health | jq .count
```
Expect stream_open=true and count>=10.

ops-bot: monitor: moss.* p50_latency, p95_latency, error_rate, kv_miss_rate. Alerts: p95>950ms or error_rate>1.8% -> page.

maria_csm: Thanks team  Action items: dylan add runbook steps to eng-oncall, akiko add curl+kv check to onboarding scripts, priya add renewal_watch rule to alerts, I'll send kickoff + 1-question poll on latency perception. I'll watch metrics during first 12h and report flags here. :eyes:
